description: This file defines the 'Description' entity class used for storing descriptive data with multi-language support, including audit information and database mapping annotations.

classes.name: Description
classes.description: Entity class representing a localized description with audit info, linked to a language, mapped for ORM.

methods.name: getAuditSection
methods.description: Returns the audit section containing audit info.

methods.name: setAuditSection
methods.description: Sets the audit section with audit info.

methods.name: getLanguage
methods.description: Returns the language associated with this description.

methods.name: setLanguage
methods.description: Sets the language for this description.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the description.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the description.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns the title associated with the description.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Sets the title of the description.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the description entity.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the description entity.
